snippet.title: Forward Toward Uranus X - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
"It's... better than you think!"

Forward Toward Uranus X is a community project consisting of 35 maps (+ 5 stopper maps) using Back To Saturn X Texture Resource. From the big name in the doom community like Dragonfly, to relatively newbie like ThatWenGuy...HEY!

Download Wad:
Doomworld: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/158465-foward-torward-uranus-x-rc1/
/idgames: COMING SOON

Music Used:
Esselfortium - Entering
Jimmy - Back To Saturn X
Esselfortium - Phobophobe
